content: शिथिल {%a.%} [श्लथ्-किलच् पृषो˚ <ls>Uṇ. 1. 53</ls>] .²1 Loose, loosened, slackened, relaxed. .²2 Untied, unfastened; विश्रामं लभतामिदं च शिथिलज्याबन्धमस्मद्धनुः <ls>Ś. 2. 6</ls>. .²2 Severed, fallen from the stalk; अर्कस्योपरि शिथिलं च्युतमिव नवमल्लिकाकुसुमम् <ls>Ś. 2. 8</ls>. .²3 Languid, enfeebled, unnerved. .²4 Weak, feeble; अशिथिलपरिरम्भ <ls>U. 1. 24</ls> ‘fast or close embrace’; <ls n="U.">1. 27</ls>. .²5 Flaccid, flabby. .²6 Dissolved. .²7 Decayed. .²8 Ineffective, futile, vain. .²9 Inattentive, careless; सुभक्ष्याणि विचित्राणि शिथिलाश्चैव योषितः <ls>Pt. 4. 116</ls>. .²10 Loosely done, not strictly or rigidly performed. .²11 Cast off, abandoned. .²12 Indistinct (as sound). .{@-लम्@} .²1 Laxity, looseness. .²2 Slowness. (शिथिलीकृ means .²1 to loosen, unfasten, untie. .²2 to relax, slacken; शिथिलीकृतेऽधिकृतकृत्यविधौ <ls>Ki. 6. 30</ls>. .²3 to weaken, impair, enfeeble. .²4 to give up, abandon; आत्मन्यवज्ञां शिथिलीचकार <ls>R. 2. 41</ls>. शिथिलीभू .²1 to be slackened or relaxed. .²2 to fall off from; एतत्तु मां दहति नष्टधनाश्रयस्य यत् सौहृदादपि जनाः शिथिलीभवन्ति <ls>Mk. 1. 13</ls>).
